title: 1x Mini Plug Callisia ‘Turtle’ – Trailing Houseplant, Creeping inchplant
description:
1x Mini Plug Callisia ‘Turtle’ (Inch Plant) 
A beautiful tender evergreen perennial with a trailing, mat-forming habit. Callisia ‘Turtle’ produces branching purplish stems that root at the nodes, covered in densely packed, slightly fleshy, pointed green leaves with a striking purple underside. In late spring and early summer, clusters of tiny white flowers appear in the leaf axils, adding extra charm.Perfect for hanging baskets, containers, or as a trailing houseplant , this variety is easy to grow and care for, making it ideal for beginners and plant lovers alike.
